title: Provision and Current
author: A. M. Crane
blurb: Wendell Quintana, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
